speaker: Doctor
text: Have you experienced any recent headaches, vision changes, or difficulty with speech and swallowing? I also need to know if you have a history of alcohol use or any autoimmune conditions.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your history of Crohn's disease and natalizumab use, I need to rule out progressive multifocal leukoencephalopathy (PML). Are you experiencing any cognitive changes, such as memory loss or confusion, or any visual disturbances like blurred vision or loss of peripheral vision?
